classification.difficultyReason: Identify which letter strokes act as the transversal and crossed lines, then mark the requested relative angle positions; W requires recognising the alternate pair in a less familiar orientation.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a large capital Z and mark two alternate angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Mark the angles between the two horizontal strokes and on opposite sides of the diagonal.

spec.description: Authored sample capital Z with labels inside its two diagonal-horizontal corners.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles on opposite sides of the diagonal transversal.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw a large capital N and mark two alternate angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Use the diagonal as the transversal of the vertical strokes. Mark interior angles on opposite sides of the diagonal.

spec.description: Authored capital N; alpha inside the upper-left corner and beta inside the lower-right corner.
spec.mathematics: Alternate angles between the vertical strokes.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Draw a large capital H and mark two co-interior angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Use the horizontal stroke as the transversal. Mark both interior angles above it.

spec.description: Authored capital H; both labels between the uprights and above the crossbar.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Draw a large capital H and mark two alternate angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Use the horizontal stroke as the transversal. Mark interior angles on opposite sides of it.

spec.description: Authored capital H; labels between the uprights on opposite sides of its crossbar.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Draw a large capital F and mark two corresponding angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Use the vertical stroke as the transversal. Mark the angles below each horizontal stroke and to the right of the vertical stroke.

spec.description: Authored capital F; labels below the upper and middle strokes, right of its upright.

children.label: f
children.prompt: Draw a large capital E and mark two co-interior angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Use the vertical stroke as the transversal of the upper and middle strokes. Mark the angles between those strokes, to the right of the vertical stroke.

spec.description: Authored capital E; labels below the upper stroke and above the middle stroke, right of the upright.

children.label: g
children.prompt: Draw a large capital E and mark two corresponding angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Use the vertical stroke as the transversal. Mark matching positions below the upper and middle horizontal strokes, to the right of the vertical stroke.

spec.description: Authored capital E; labels in matching lower-right sectors at the upper and middle junctions.

children.label: h
children.prompt: Draw a large capital W and mark two alternate angles with $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

answer.worked: Use the second stroke as a transversal of the first and third strokes. Mark the angle at the first lower vertex and the angle at the middle upper vertex.

spec.description: Authored capital W; alpha inside the first lower corner and beta inside the middle upper corner.
spec.mathematics: First and third strokes crossed by the second stroke; marked angles are interior on opposite sides of that transversal.
